page.overview:
Who is Blueno?

Blueno is an agent of CP0. Before the time skip, he was previously an agent of CP9; operating undercover as the bartender of a bar in Water 7.

He was one of the major antagonists during the Water 7 Arc and a minor antagonist during the Enies Lobby Arc.

He is a tall man with big lips, a black beard, and black hair in which his hairstyle resembles the horns of a bull. During his time as a bartender, he wore a black and yellow polka-dotted shirt with an apron over it. As a CP9 agent, he wore a black two-piece suit with a white handkerchief in his breast pocket and a sweater undershirt.

During his contact with Robin in Water 7 and the attempts to assassinate Iceburg, he wore a checkered pattern cloak with necklaces of beads. Accompanying this costume, he wore two masks. First, he wore a mask with lipstick and markings that go over the eyes and down the cheeks. He then donned a sleepy smiling bear mask after the former was left in the Galley-La Company.
